text: Alright, we're laying out the festival grounds and I need this done before the meeting. The Entrance goes at the bottom, in the center. The Stage should be at the top, big and red, since that's the main attraction. Put the Bar to the left of the Stage and the Toilets to the right of it. Hmm, the Toilets shouldn't be that close, move them 120 pixels further right. Draw a line from Entrance to the Venue, no arrowhead. Is the Venue still the shape with the most connections? Oh also, I think there's a link between Bar and Toilets that shouldn't be there, so cut it. Could you also list everything that is near the Stage? Thanks!!
Geography quiz sketch. link the Rhine to the Alps. Make the Alps a huge gray triangle. The Rhine should be a blue circle. Is the Rhine reachable from the Alps?

Fridge inventory diagram, I'm planning the weekly shop. Do I have more than one purple thing in there? Ha. count the purple ones. Make the Milk a big white rectangle. The Eggs are small and yellow. Butter should be a gold square. Put the Milk on the left, the Eggs in the middle and the Butter on the right. Link the Milk to the Eggs and the Eggs to the Butter. Is the Butter reachable from the Milk? How many squares do we have? Which one is the rightmost? Tell me the neighbors of the Eggs. Rename the Butter to Spread. Thanks, shopping list time.
Astronomy flashcard. Is the Moon gray? it looks white. Make the Moon a small white circle. Put it at the top right. How big is the Moon?

Drama class cast diagram. Claudius should be a big black square, Hamlet a medium blue circle and Ophelia a small white one. Link Hamlet to Ophelia and Hamlet to Claudius. Is Claudius connected to Ophelia? Put Hamlet at the center.

Pipeline stages for my build system. Put A, B, C, D in a row, no wait a column. Make the gap even. Make A green, B blue, C orange and D red. Link A, B, C and D in a chain. Is D reachable from A? Which stage has the most connections? Put A at the top. Make D a huge star. Is B bigger than C? How many connections are there? Rename D to Final. Tell me what color C is. Thanks, my build was broken.
Car brand chart. what shapes are the cars? Make the Audi red and the Bmw blue. Is the Audi bigger than the Bmw? Link the Audi to the Bmw with a dashed line.

App navigation map, version two. Add a star called Fav to the bottom right. And link Home to it dotted. Make Home a big green circle. Profile is blue and Settings is gray. Make the Fav gold. Link Home to Profile and Home to Settings. Is Settings connected to Profile? Put Home at the top. Put Profile and Settings in a row. Which shape is the closest to Home? Count the connections. Rename Settings to Prefs. Thanks, I will check it tomorrow.

Menu for the dinner party. Make Dessert twice as big. Hmm, can't say that, I mean enlarge it. Make the Starter yellow and the Main red. Link Starter, Main and Dessert in a chain. Is the Dessert reachable from the Starter?

Hi, I am a rail enthusiast and I'm drawing the Norwegian network from memory. Oslo is the hub. Link Oslo to Bergen, Trondheim and Tromso with no arrows because trains go both ways. Actually make them two-way arrows, I like the look better. Tromso is far north so move it to the top, would you? Bergen should be left of Oslo. And Trondheim ought to go between Oslo and Tromso. After that, show me the shortest connection from Bergen to Tromso. How many links do we have? Also, is Oslo larger than Bergen? Hope my geography isn't too bad.
Product roadmap. Pls put MVP below Idea. Make the Idea a big yellow star. Link the Idea to the Mvp. Is the Mvp connected to the Idea?
Pet database sketch. what is cats position. Make the Cat gray and the Dog brown. Is the Dog bigger than the Cat?

Clock face diagram. Make the Hour a rectangle. Then change Minute to a rectangle too, but long... skip that, just rectangle. Make the Hour blue and the Minute red. Is the Minute bigger than the Hour? Link them with a plain line.

Fantasy quest storyboard for my D&D group, hear me out. the Hero fights the Dragon: connect them with a red dashed line and put a label "fight" on it. The Hero is a big blue circle. The Dragon should be a huge red triangle. The Princess is a small pink star. Put the Hero on the left, the Dragon in the middle and the Princess on the right. Connect the Dragon to the Princess, it guards her. Is the Hero connected to the Princess? Which shape is the farthest from the Hero? Is the Dragon bigger than the Hero? How many triangles do we have? Rename the Princess to Zelda. Thanks, session is tonight!
Place four green circles, each tiny. Put them near the Tomato. They are seedlings, you know. Make the Tomato red and the Cucumber green. Is the Tomato bigger than the Cucumber?
Lunch menu. Please swap Salad and Soup, then delete Salad. Actually don't delete it. Make the Salad green. Soup should be orange. Is the Salad near the Soup?

Biology homework, central dogma. The Dna makes the Rna and the Rna makes the Protein. Make the Dna a big blue rectangle. Rna is a green circle and Protein is a red star. Is the Protein reachable from the Dna? Which shape is the rightmost?
Puzzle graph. Everything reachable from P1? Link P1 to P2 and P2 to P3. Make P3 a red star. Is P3 reachable from P1?
Circus program. get the Clown to the top left. Make the Clown a small red circle. The Tent should be a huge yellow triangle. Is the Clown near the Tent?

I am checking my bridge sketch and have a list of requests. The Beam should be a long rectangle, so call it a rectangle and make it huge. The Joint is a small gray hexagon. Hang the Load below the Beam. Connect the Cable to the Support and the Load, in that order. Wait, I meant to the Beam and the Load. Is there any cycle in this? There shouldn't be. Count the connections, I expect four. And what is the Support connected to right now? If it is to nothing then I should add a link. Thank you so much, this is a huge help.
Color theory class. The shape called Red is actually blue. Funny. Make Red a big circle. Is Red a circle now?

Org chart for our tiny startup, the boss is looking over my shoulder. set the intern to tiny, boss huge. Make the Boss a gold star. The Intern is a green circle. Link the Boss to the Intern. Put the Boss at the top and the Intern at the bottom. Is the Intern connected to the Boss? Which shape is the biggest? Rename the Intern to Trainee, HR insists. Is the Boss near the Intern? Count the connections. Thanks, boss is happy.
Portfolio sketch. stock beside bond. Make the Stock a green circle and the Bond a gray square. Link the Stock to the Bond. Is the Bond bigger than the Stock?
Tennis court layout. Which is bigger than the Court? Make the Court a huge green rectangle. The Net should be a small white rectangle. Put the Net at the center. Is the Net near the Court?
Counting game. Put them all in a row, then distribute them horizontally. Make One red, Two green and Three blue. Which one is the leftmost?
Smart home wiring. Is the Switch connected to the Lamp? Make the Switch a small gray square. Link the Switch to the Lamp. Is the Lamp reachable from the Switch?

Forest inventory for my ecology project, bear with the mess. Paint the oak brown, uh the Oak, brown, and the Pine green. Make the Birch white. Link Oak, Pine and Birch in a chain. Is Birch connected to Oak? Which tree has the most links? Make the Oak a huge circle. Pine should be a large triangle. Put the Oak at the left, Pine in the middle and Birch at the right. Is the Pine bigger than the Birch? Count the connections. Rename the Birch to Aspen. Thanks!
Three little pigs storyboard. make a new triangle and call it Straw... no, a square called Brick. Make the Wolf gray and the Pig pink. Link the Wolf to the House. Is the Wolf near the House?
Office floor. The Printer is in the way. Slide it left by 60. Make the Printer a big gray rectangle. Link the Scanner to the Printer. Is the Printer bigger than the Scanner?

Physics diagram. How far away is the Wall from the Mass? I can't really tell. Which one is farthest from the Spring? Link Wall, Spring and Mass in a chain. Make the Mass a big red circle. Is the Wall connected to the Mass?

Let me tell you how my sprint board works, and then you tell me if it's right. Todo1 and Todo2 are both waiting items. Doing1 is in progress, Done1 is finished. I want the colors to match this: waiting is yellow, in progress is orange, finished is green. So paint Todo1 and Todo2 yellow, Doing1 orange, and Done1 green. Then connect Todo1 to Doing1 and Doing1 to Done1. Is Todo2 connected to anything? If not I'd like to link it to Doing1 as well. Whew. Also, what does the whole board look like now? Oh, and make Done1 a star. That's it.
Town map. Add three triangles. Make the Bakery a big orange square. How many triangles are there?

Model railway. Couple the Wagon1 to the Loco, and then Wagon2 to Wagon1, chain style. Make the Loco a big black rectangle. Wagon1 and Wagon2 should be small brown rectangles. Is Wagon2 connected to the Loco?

Binary tree sketch. Root should be at the top, Left below-left... so left of... ugh. Just put Left to the left of Root, and Right to the right. Make the Root a big red circle. Link the Root to Left and Right. Put the Root at the top.

Gallery wall planning, small museum project. label the Frame "Mona" and rename the frame to Louvre. Make the Frame a big gold rectangle. Add a small white circle called Photo near the Frame. Connect the Photo to the Frame with a dotted line. Make the Photo a star. How many circles do we have? Is the Photo near the Frame? Put the Frame at the center. Which shape is the closest to the Frame? Tell me the neighbors of the Frame. Duplicate the Frame twice. Thanks!

Make a yellow circle and name it Smile. Then another one, a smaller one. Is that too much?

Italy trip planner, the cities we visit in order. Arrange Rome, Milan and Turin in a circle. Make Rome a big red star. Milan is blue and Turin is green. Link Rome to Milan and Milan to Turin. Is Turin reachable from Rome? Which city is the most connected? Put Rome at the bottom and Turin at the top. Rename Milan to Milano. Is Rome bigger than Turin? How many connections are there? Make Turin a huge circle. Perfect, thanks.
Sports equipment chart. From now on make everything I draw large. Make the Ball a small white circle. The Bat should be a long... a large brown rectangle. Is the Bat bigger than the Ball?
Ocean food web. the Shark is bigger than the Tuna. And the Tuna is below the Shark. Make the Shark gray and the Tuna blue. Link Tuna to Shark with an arrow. Is the Shark reachable from the Tuna?
Floor2 on top of Floor1, Floor3 on top of Floor2. Then make them all gray. That's a skyscraper. Is Floor3 above Floor2? Link them in a chain.

Auth flow sketch. I want a small red circle named Error on the right side of the canvas, connected to Login with a dashed arrow. Make the Login a big blue rectangle. Is the Login connected to the Error?
